title: 第19章 奥尔山巅星痕之谜第20章 装逼逆转
lines: 山门石眼齐齐转动，蓝白纹路从岩缝里爬出，沿着整面山壁一路向上。
赤金破阵锥嗡嗡加压，契约锁链扎进外环符文。商会破阵师趴在铁架后，手指飞快拨动铜盘。
“外环可拆！拓印阵图！”
灰烬祭司骨杖一压，黑星火贴着岩壁阴影窜出，灰烬星纹一枚枚钉入裂缝。
山门正中，那枚白色暗鹰追踪钉晶眼闪了最后一下。
绮兰抬手，银红契约光网罩住山门三十步。
“长夏在看。”
“让他看个马赛克。”洛晖掌心蓝火一甩，山印贴上石眼下方凹槽。
契约光网收紧，暗鹰晶眼里的画面碎成蓝火、黑影、石门轮廓。钉尾白光挣扎两下，咔的一声裂开。
远端看不到了。
商会领队举起短剑。
“赤金商会对无主星痕遗迹拥有先占权！阻拦者，视同破坏流通秩序！”
洛晖抬手指向破阵锥。
“门都没开，你们账本先到了。马尔契教你们做生意，第一课叫脸皮镀金？”
破阵锥猛地一震，外泄星火顺锁链倒灌。洛晖掌心星痕流转一转，把那股星火引偏到侧翼铁架。
轰！
两名破阵师连人带架翻下台阶，赤金烟火炸得满地乱滚。
洛晖吹了吹指尖灰。
“第二课，别把炮口对着自己。”
灰烬祭司趁乱念咒，黑星火贴地扑向洛晖脚下山印。绮雯从阴影中横切，暗影之刃刃心蓝色净火一亮，刀锋斩断黑火前端。
黑火残波卷回岩缝。
绮雯掌心绷带被暗紫光顶起，她反手将短符钉进地面。
“灰烬祭司要污染山门。提取星痕时，黑星火会顺你的星纹灌进去。”
洛晖没有回头。
“谢谢提醒。你负责给暗教修剪指甲。”
绮雯一刀扎入影子。
“你负责少死两次。”
山门防御被三股力量搅乱，岩壁上十几块石胎脱落。小型星辰石卫从石胎里站起，高约一人，胸口嵌着黯淡星晶，石矛横扫所有活物。
商会精英后撤，影刃刺客贴墙躲避。
洛晖反向冲入石卫队列。
“别砸核心！”
绮兰手套一抬，契约光线缠住三尊石卫脚踝。
洛晖星火光刃压到极细，连斩七次。石卫膝关节符文被切开，身体砸在地面，胸口星晶仍在亮。
绮兰扫过那些倒地石卫，随即把一枚银红印记打进山门外环。
“他没毁核心。主阵还没彻底敌对。”
“那就继续保持礼貌。”洛晖抬脚踢起一面石盾。
侧翼商会小型炼金炮喷出赤红弹丸。洛晖手腕一翻，石盾挡住弹丸，星火在盾面一转。
弹丸倒飞回破阵锥旁。
轰！
content_en:
The stone eyes of the mountain gate rotate in unison, and blue and white lines crawl out of the rock cracks and go up along the entire mountain wall.
The red gold formation-breaking cone buzzed and pressed, and the contract chain penetrated the outer ring runes. The formation breaker of the Chamber of Commerce lay down behind the iron frame and quickly moved the copper plate with his fingers.
"The outer ring is detachable! The formation pattern is printed!"
As soon as the Ash Priest's bone staff pressed, black sparks shot out against the shadow of the rock wall, and the Ash Star patterns were nailed into the cracks one by one.
In the middle of the mountain gate, the white dark eagle tracking nail flashed for the last time.
Qilan raised her hand, and the silver-red contract light net covered the mountain gate for thirty steps.
"Chang Xia is watching."
"Let him see a mosaic." Luo Hui flicked the blue fire in his palm, and the mountain seal was attached to the groove under the stone eye.
The contract light net tightened, and the picture in Dark Eagle's crystal eyes shattered into blue fire, black shadows, and the outline of the stone gate. The white light on the nail tail struggled twice and cracked with a click.
The far end is no longer visible.
The leader of the Chamber of Commerce raised his dagger.
"The Red Gold Chamber of Commerce has the first right to occupy the ownerless star mark ruins! Anyone who blocks it will be regarded as disrupting the circulation order!"
Luo Hui raised his hand and pointed at the broken formation cone.
"The door hasn't even been opened yet, and your account book arrived first. Marchi teaches you how to do business. The first lesson is about gilding your face?"
The formation-breaking cone shook violently, leaking sparks pouring down the chain. The star mark in Luo Hui's palm moved around, deflecting the spark to the iron frame on the side.
boom!
The two formation breaker masters climbed down the steps with their bodies, and red gold fireworks exploded all over the ground.
Luo Hui blew the dust off his fingertips.
"Lesson two, don't point the muzzle at yourself."
The Ash Priest took advantage of the chaos to recite a spell, and the black sparks flew towards the mountain mark at the foot of Luo Hui. Qiwen cut across from the shadow, the blue pure fire at the center of the shadow blade lit up, and the blade cut off the front end of the black fire.
The remaining waves of black fire rolled back into the rock crevice.
The bandage on Qiwen's palm was lifted up by the dark purple light, and she nailed the short talisman into the ground with her backhand.
"The Ash Priest wants to pollute the mountain gate. When extracting the star marks, the black sparks will pour in along your star marks."
Luo Hui did not look back.
"Thanks for the reminder. You are responsible for trimming the nails of the Dark Cult."
Qiwen stabbed into the shadow.
"You are responsible for at least two deaths."
The defense of the mountain gate was disrupted by three forces, and more than a dozen stone tires fell off the rock wall. The small star stone guard stood up from the stone body, about one person tall, with a dim star crystal embedded in its chest, and its stone spear swept across all living creatures.
The elites of the Chamber of Commerce retreated, while the Shadow Blade Assassins stuck to the wall to avoid.
Luo Hui rushed into the stone guard queue in the opposite direction.
"Don't hit the core!"
Qilan raised her gloves, and the contract light wrapped around the ankles of the three stone guards.
Luo Huixing's flaming blade was pressed to an extremely fine point, and he slashed seven times in a row. The runes on Shi Wei's knee joints were cut open, and his body hit the ground. The star crystal on his chest was still shining.
Qilan swept over the fallen stone guards and then punched a silver-red mark into the outer ring of the mountain gate.
"He has not destroyed the core. The main formation is not completely hostile yet."
"Then continue to be polite." Luo Hui raised his foot and kicked up a stone shield.
The small alchemy cannon of the Chamber of Commerce on the flank sprayed red projectiles. Luo Hui flipped his wrist, the stone shield blocked the projectiles, and the sparks turned on the shield.
The projectile flew back to the cone of destruction.
boom!
title_en: Chapter 19 The mystery of the star marks on the top of Orr Mountain Chapter 20 Pretending to reverse
